DIAGNOSIS READY: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS).

Given the 3-month progression of gait difficulties now requiring wheelchair use, combined with a 1-year history of urinary incontinence and recent bulbar symptoms like speech slurring, the clinical picture strongly suggests a motor neuron disease affecting both upper and lower motor neurons. The chronic nature of the incontinence and the rapid decline in ambulation over the last few months are concerning. Please confirm if there is any history of muscle twitching (fasciculations) or muscle weakness in your arms or legs, and if you have experienced any sensory changes like numbness or tingling.
